dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Gila County, local Forest Service administration, and regional veterans served by the property.
Involves a single property conveyance of about 232.9 acres for veteran support use.
dimensions.evidence: consisting of approximately 232.9 acres of National Forest System land located in the Tonto National Forest in Arizona

dimensions.assessment: The conveyance is made without consideration, and the county pays all associated administrative and survey costs.
dimensions.evidence: made without consideration... the County shall pay all costs associated with the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: A localized land conveyance measure with no broader regulatory or statutory changes.
Permanent transfer of title, subject to a reversion clause if the land is used inconsistently with veteran support purposes.
dimensions.evidence: If any land conveyed under subsection (b) is used in a manner that is inconsistent with the requirements of subsection (g), all right, title, and interest in and to the land shall revert to the United States

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires a specific tract of federal land (approximately 232.9 acres) in Arizona to be conveyed to Gila County for supporting veterans.
